items.title: Secure MCP integrations for AWS DevOps Agent with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: As you connect more Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools to AWS DevOps Agent, each one adds its own authentication, credential rotation, and audit overhead. This post shows how to extend AWS DevOps Agent with MCP tools securely using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, so new tools inherit consistent security, access control, private connectivity, and observability.
items.creator: Lakshmi Kumkala
